query:
-- Keep only the lowest id per openId, delete all duplicates
-- First reassign any page_views/sessions from duplicates to the canonical row
UPDATE page_views pv
JOIN (
  SELECT openId, MIN(id) as canonical_id
  FROM users
  WHERE openId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY openId
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) canon ON pv.userId IN (
  SELECT id FROM users u2
  WHERE u2.openId = (SELECT openId FROM users WHERE id = pv.userId)
  AND u2.id != canon.canonical_id
)
SET pv.userId = canon.canonical_id;

-- Delete all duplicate user rows (non-canonical)
DELETE u FROM users u
WHERE u.openId IS NOT NULL
AND u.id NOT IN (
  SELECT canonical_id FROM (
    SELECT MIN(id) as canonical_id
    FROM users
    WHERE openId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY openId
  ) as mins
);

-- Verify final counts
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_users FROM users;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT openId) as distinct_openids FROM users WHERE openId IS NOT NULL;
